content.comment_body: Remove any duplicate IP addresses from your network setup.

analysis.insight_summary: A user encountered difficulties accessing the Web Based Management interface for a [product_name] communication module, as signaled by a blinking status LED. Addressing this network configuration issue is necessary to regain stable connectivity and proper module operation.
